desc: The Zastava M70 scope mount is the perfect solution for someone looking to add a high quality low profile rail for their Yugo AK47 rifle. The high quality aluminum construction is light weight and solid in design and function. The adjustable tension for the QD lever allow you to ensure good fitment while also being able to easily put on or remove the rail without changing zero. The optic mount comes with a angled piece of rail attached that allow you to mount lasers or other accessories to your rifle. If you need a rail with your M70 pattern rifle this is the one for you.
